name: How are movable tiny homes transported and set up?

mainEntity.name: How are movable tiny homes transported and set up?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zen Tiny Homes are transported by licensed movers with equipment suited for large loads. Setup includes placement, leveling, utility hookups, and safety inspections.
